violation_type.title: Medication Records - Name of Employee Who Administered (26 TAC §744.2655(c)(4))
violation_type.short_title: Medication Records - Name of Employee Who Administered
violation_type.typical_finding: At the time of inspection the medication log was not documented with the required informaiton. The single log entry (6/25/25) did not include the time, name or amount of the medication or the name of the person who administered it. This was corrected at inspection by staff completing the log to include all required information.
